question: The ‘Western disturbances’ originates from the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mediterranean Sea**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Western disturbances** are extratropical storms that originate over the **Mediterranean Sea**.
 
• These disturbances are carried towards the Indian subcontinent by the westerly winds.
